0e23d6571f9e.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev2 Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Key:secret Action:block To: CreatedAt:}]}
0e23d6571f9e.sql:
WITH a AS (
  UNPIVOT (
    SELECT COLUMNS('^(day|attr_.*)$'), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "attr_$"
    FROM events
    WHERE family IN ('views') AND "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
  )
  ON COLUMNS('^attr_') INTO NAME col VALUE attr_value
),
k AS (
  SELECT substr(col, 6) AS attr_key, count(*) AS events, count(DISTINCT attr_value) AS "values"
  FROM a
  GROUP BY col
)
SELECT attr_key, events, "values", count(*) OVER () AS keys_total
FROM k
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (ORDER BY events DESC, attr_key) <= 100
ORDER BY events DESC, attr_key
